explanation: I found no Mathlib declaration that states this result. `restrictScalarsEquiv` and `restrictScalarsLevelEquiv` are defined by the library itself, in RestrictScalars.lean at lines 104 and 52. The theorem says that this equivalence sends `of (I.map (algebraMap R S)) M x` to `of I M x`, so its content depends on the library's own definitions. I searched `Mathlib/RingTheory/AdicCompletion` for `restrictScalars`. The only hits are general submodule, algebra-hom and SModEq restrict-scalars lemmas. None of them gives an equivalence between the I-adic completion and the completion at the ideal image of I in S (`I.map (algebraMap R S)`). The proof is just `AdicCompletion.ext` plus the library's own level lemma.
